facts.claim: A GB300 NVL72 rack is one NVLink domain of 72 GPUs.
Fabric Manager configures and monitors the NVSwitch fabric.
A persistent Fabric Manager crash leaves the domain untrusted, so the whole rack drains.
facts.wrong: Fabric Manager only passes messages between nodes.
